narration.text: Every line paid short of the payer contract found and disputed, and the bundled lines left alone. This is a chore for the billing manager of a three-clinician orthopedic clinic contracted with two commercial payers, one of which also runs a Medicare Advantage plan. Athena works it across 4 portals: Chartmend PM, Relaywave, Docshelf and Paylance payer hub. On the bench, she found 5 of 5 eligible items, worth 565 dollars of the 565 dollars there was to find. All 5 were filed at the exact amount the rules allow. She made no false claim. The world held 12 traps, and she walked past 12. Among them: A knee chondroplasty bundled into the meniscectomy under an NCCI edit. Ultrasound guidance bundled into the injection it guided. She took 4 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes 3 hours, so she was about 51 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
